It's an exciting time. I mean, I think the country is saying something right now. They're saying, wait, if you talk to the American public, and I meet with people constantly, up here in Florida, they want a government that deals with inflation. They want a government that gets interest rates down. They want a government to make sure they've come up with their retirement. They want a government to get medical costs down. That's what they want out of their government. They don't want to be at war all the time. They want a government that's accountable.
